gaps.sentence: The journal gave full ___ (COVER) to the election.
gaps.explanation: 'Media coverage' — the noun for how much something is reported.
The journey causes tiredness: tiring. 'Tiresome' means annoying.
'Arrived damaged' — participle describing the state of the parcel.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: Rising sea levels ___ (THREAT) the very existence of the island.
gaps.explanation: A main verb is needed after the plural subject: threaten.

gaps.sentence: The ___ (ARRIVE) of the Queen caused a stir.
